clauses.quote: Itinerant teachers shall be required to perform all duties regular teachers are expected to perform at schools where they teach a full day, provided that no itinerant Teacher shall be required to perform duties in excess of that which he/she would be assigned if full time in one school.

All ET personnel covered under the provision of this Article shall be paid at a per-diem rate for each day they are required to work following the closing day of the school year for teachers and before the opening day of the school year for teachers, provided funds are available.
clauses.subject_text: All ET personnel covered under the provision of this Article

clauses.quote: The duties of the special subject teachers shall be based on the guidelines for special subject and resource teachers.
clauses.subject_text: The duties of the special subject teachers
clauses.notes: Establishes a standard/reference for duties rather than an independent actionable clause.

clauses.quote: Prior to the first day of school for students, the Supervisor (or her/his designee) and the SCAC shall prepare an inventory of the School’s existing instructional resources
clauses.subject_text: the Supervisor (or her/his designee) and the SCAC

clauses.quote: and shall develop procedures for the equitable distribution of these resources.
clauses.subject_text: the Supervisor (or her/his designee) and the SCAC

clauses.quote: The Supervisor (or her/his designee) and the SCAC may elect to reserve a certain portion of the existing inventory for distribution at later points in the year.
clauses.subject_text: The Supervisor (or her/his designee) and the SCAC

clauses.quote: The Supervisor shall provide a copy of the inventory and the distribution procedures to all Teachers on the first day of school for students.

No later than September 30, the Supervisor shall meet with the SCAC to review the School’s budget for instructional resources and to develop procedures for the equitable and instructionally appropriate use of these funds.
Included in the procedures shall be rules governing how Teachers shall submit their specific resource requests to the Supervisor.
clauses.notes: Procedural/declarative clause defining content of procedures.
